mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.name AS author_name FROM announcements a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id ORDER BY a.pinned DESC, a.created_at DESC
SELECT a.*, u.name AS author_name FROM announcements a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcements (author_id, title, content, pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{pinned}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
